details.parties_quote:
Lakeshore Grocers Inc., an Illinois corporation having its principal office at 222 West Wacker Drive, 14th Floor, Chicago, Illinois 60606 ("Lakeshore"); and

payment_source.quote: Lakeshore shall pay undisputed amounts within thirty (30) days of receipt of invoice.

details.services_summary: Retail analytics modernization including data warehouse migration, ingestion pipelines, semantic layer, and Power BI dashboards.

liability_cap.basis: FEES PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THE APPLICABLE SOW IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM
liability_cap.quote: EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THE APPLICABLE SOW IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM, EXCEPT FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.

delay_penalty.quote: If Vendor fails to complete a milestone by the date specified in the SOW due to causes attributable to Vendor, Lakeshore may assess liquidated damages of one-half percent (0.5%) of the affected Milestone Fee per week of delay, up to a maximum of five percent (5%) of that Milestone Fee.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Neither party shall solicit the other's employees engaged in the Services during the term and for twelve months thereafter.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: solicit the other's employees engaged in the Services
restrictive_covenants.quote: Neither party shall solicit the other's employees engaged in the Services during the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter.

findings.title: US entity with courts or arbitration outside the US (Singapore)
findings.why: AtliQ Inc has no presence abroad; a dispute would be run in a foreign forum.
findings.comparison: Principle: US law and US courts for AtliQ Inc.
findings.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Illinois, without regard to its conflict of laws rules. ... Any dispute not so resolved shall be finally resolved by arbitration administered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre ("SIAC") in accordance with the SIAC Arbitration Rules then in force. The seat of arbitration shall be Singapore.

findings.title: Crestline Retail Inc: Offering lower rates to any other customer for substantially similar services
findings.why: Requires ensuring Crestline Retail Inc receives the benefit of any lower pricing offered for substantially similar services worldwide.
findings.comparison: Any rate below Crestline's rate card for similar services (for example a senior data engineer under $85/hr) triggers a retroactive credit to Crestline.
findings.quote: Supplier represents and warrants that the rates, fees and other commercial terms offered to Crestline under this Agreement are and shall remain no less favorable than those offered by Supplier or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services during the Term.
findings.exception: Lower rates must be reported and applied to Crestline retroactively, with a credit within 30 days. Rate card: Senior Data Engineer $85/hr, Data Engineer $62/hr, BI Developer $58/hr.

findings.title: Uncapped liability for confidentiality, indemnification, and gross negligence
findings.why: Removes the liability cap for common claims, exposing AtliQ to disproportionate financial risk.
findings.comparison: AtliQ prefers a strict 1x cap on fees without broad carve-outs that destroy the protection.
findings.quote: EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE... EXCEPT FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.

findings.title: CloudSpan Technologies: Acting as implementation, reseller or referral partner for any competing cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or analytics platform
findings.why: Involves a lakehouse platform for Lakeshore Grocers Inc, which might collide if cloud data-warehouse or lakehouse platform implementation occurs within specified Middle East/India geographies (though Lakeshore is in the US).
findings.comparison: Do not partner with another cloud data-warehouse or lakehouse vendor in India or the GCC while the CloudSpan agreement runs.
findings.quote: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.
findings.exception: Clause 7.3: does not restrict services outside India and the GCC, or to a customer that independently selected a platform, provided AtliQ holds no partner appointment with, and receives no fee from, that platform's provider.

findings.title: Automatic annual renewal requires tracking
findings.why: Locks AtliQ into extended terms if notice is missed.
findings.comparison: Not explicitly mentioned in AtliQ principles; requires internal tracking to avoid accidental lock-in.
findings.quote: renewing automatically for successive one-year periods unless either party gives sixty (60) days' notice of non-renewal.

findings.title: One-way IP Indemnity for AtliQ
findings.why: Indemnity is not mutual for IP infringement claims, placing all IP risk on AtliQ.
findings.quote: Vendor shall defend and indemnify Lakeshore against third-party claims alleging that the Deliverables infringe a U.S. patent, copyright or trademark or misappropriate a trade secret.
